promptSpec: recognize-mc — target text shown, native meaning picked. {shown:TargetText, correctMeaning, distractors:[3], instruction} e.g. {"type":"recognize-mc","shown":{"text":"el perro","reading":null},"correctMeaning":"the dog","distractors":["the cat","the bread","the house"],"instruction":null,"itemIds":["i1"],"explanation":null}
rulesSpec: - recognize-mc: exactly one of the four options may be correct given "shown"; if two would both answer it, rewrite it. The closer the distractors sit to correctMeaning without being a second right answer, the better the challenge.
paramsSpec: - words: how many words the target text in "shown" should have.

spanish.explanation: "La cuenta" is what you ask the waiter for at the end of a meal.
